title: Graffiti Tunnels
content: So I often dream about these tunnels under a mall. It's under the Federal Way Commons Mall which I used to visit when I was a teen. The entrance is about where the Sears was. Anyway, the tunnels have pattern tile floor in light yellow, seafoam green, and white. The floor is grimy. The walls have graffiti like floor to ceiling, super ornate picture that I think are names. The vieling is maybe 14 feet high but the tunnels are narrow, maybe 6 to 8 feet across, and dark. I use my phone flashlight to navigate and take pictures of the graffiti. The tunnels are full of roving groups of men, wild dogs, and sometimes demons/naga who will hurt you if they find you. I haven't ran into them but I often hear them yelling in the distance. At the center of these tunnels is a greenhouse courtyard with skylights. There a lot of overgrown tropical plants there and an empty pool. It's usually full of golden light and the demons/men/naga/dogs can't enter. I usually chill here until I wake up or until the dream shifts. Until the other night I entered the greenhouse and it was getting dark. I could tell that once it was completely dark the tunnel boards would be able to get me. They started mocking me and trying to convince me to simply enter the tunnels and get it over with, which was more annoying than scary. Then as it was nearly dark came these two guys in trench coats and derby hats like a noir detective. They had no faces, instead beautiful black masks that were completely smooth and decorated with delicate blue flowers like on a fancy china plate. They informed me that the two of them were a singular angel and they'd see me tomorrow, and I woke up.
